summary: Frontend-only test of Suvera FLOW login + unauth flows. Login screen renders correctly (logo, email/password, show/hide toggle, submit). Empty submit shows exact validation 'Enter your email and password.'. Submitting md@demo.test / MdUser@12345 against the unreachable external backend (https://suveraflow.in - confirmed TLS/connect failure, net::ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH) correctly surfaces the network banner 'Cannot reach the Suvera FLOW server. Check your connection.' with no crash. Unauth navigation to /console, /reception, /admin all redirect to /login via the RoleTabs guard. HOWEVER, /history and /audit have NO auth guard: they render for unauthenticated users and fire protected API calls, which is a security/UX bug. Deprecated 'shadow*' style props warning observed (should migrate to boxShadow).

ui_bugs.issue: No auth guard. Unauthenticated direct navigation to /history renders the HistoryView screen and fires GET /api/visits/history?range=week without a token. Expected: redirect to /login like RoleTabs does.

No auth guard. Unauthenticated direct navigation to /audit renders the screen and fires GET /api/admin/audit without a token (useQuery has no 'enabled: status===signedIn'). Expected: redirect to /login.

issues: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears on every screen load — a shared UI component (likely in src/components/ui.tsx or theme) still uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset. Migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props detected in console warnings on every screen. React Native 0.76+ expects 'boxShadow'. Reference: src/components/ui.tsx / src/theme.ts (grep for shadowColor/shadowOpacity).

action_items: Add auth guard to /app/frontend/app/history.tsx and /app/frontend/app/audit.tsx (mirror RoleTabs: if status==='signedOut' return <Redirect href="/login" />; optionally restrict audit to role==='admin'). Also gate the useQuery with enabled: status==='signedIn'.
Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' React Native style props to 'boxShadow' (check src/components/ui.tsx and src/theme.ts).
No action for external backend — confirmed unreachable (TLS handshake failure) as per the problem statement; the app already handles it gracefully.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts: Correctly converts network/TLS failures into ApiError(0, 'Cannot reach the Suvera FLOW server. Check your connection.'). Good.
src/auth.tsx: login() flow is clean; token+user persisted via secure storage; setUnauthorizedHandler wired to clearSession on 401. Good.
src/queue.ts: useQueueState is correctly gated with enabled: status==='signedIn' — unauth users won't fire /api/queue/state. Good.
src/LiveSync.tsx: WebSocket only connects when status==='signedIn' && token — safe.
src/components/RoleTabs.tsx: Properly redirects signedOut -> /login and wrong-role -> homeFor(user.role). Good.
app/history.tsx and app/audit.tsx: MISSING auth guard — security/UX regression. They render for unauth users and fire authenticated API calls.
app/_layout.tsx + app/index.tsx: Root wiring correct; shows splash while fonts load, index redirects based on auth status.
app/console/_layout.tsx, app/reception/_layout.tsx, app/admin/_layout.tsx: All call useQueueState() at layout level. Because useQueueState is gated by auth status, no unauthenticated API fire — Good.
login.tsx: Validation and error UI match the requirement exactly, including testIDs login-logo, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-toggle-password, login-submit-button, login-error-text.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (login flows pass; /history and /audit missing auth guards)

context_for_next_testing_agent: External backend https://suveraflow.in is intentionally down (TLS handshake failure / Cloudflare 1001). Do NOT create a local backend. Login flow (render, validation, network-error banner) works perfectly. RoleTabs guards for /console, /reception, /admin all redirect unauth to /login. Only /history and /audit lack guards — retest after main agent adds Redirect. Mobile viewport 390x844 used.
rca_of_issue: Root cause for /history and /audit bug: these screens are top-level routes in app/ but do not use the RoleTabs guard pattern. app/history.tsx and app/audit.tsx render immediately and invoke useQuery with no auth-status gate, so an unauthenticated visitor sees a protected screen's shell and triggers an unauthenticated API call. Reproduction: in a fresh/incognito session navigate directly to /history or /audit — the screens render and SSL/network errors fire against the backend. Mitigation: at the top of each screen component, add: const { status, user } = useAuth(); if (status === 'signedOut') return <Redirect href='/login' />; (and for /audit optionally gate on user?.role === 'admin'). Additionally pass enabled: status === 'signedIn' to the useQuery calls in HistoryView and audit.tsx.
